purpose: local alpha cleanup only; no RGB/anatomy repaint
reason: Only manually inspected contour-region background colors are rejected; protected original hair interior keeps even pale/cool highlights without creating pinholes.
rule: Begin with raw mask luminance. Rasterize protectedOriginalHairInterior using Pillow ImageDraw polygon. Within region and outside protection and where raw luminance>0, set luminance=0 if (R<G) or (B>R+10 and G>R-5) or (G-B>65 and R-G<35). All other luminance bytes unchanged; source RGB read only.
